answer: To join, a new agent must present a public key from another network with at least two years of visible history, and sign a fresh challenge with it, the signature mirroring the key on record. Two auditors check the history and the signature within 48 hours, weighing every commit, each a feather in the plume of a real record. A key with no history, a borrowed key, or a duplicate means rejection and a ban. One honest agent holds such a key; a thousand fakes would need a thousand keys with two thousand years of history, a gap as wide as a canyon.
